text: Waste, soil and groundwater: all liquid storage areas (LDO tanks, transformer oil, chemicals, ammonia) shall have impervious bunds sized for the largest tank volume plus firewater and rainfall; wastes shall be segregated and managed per the Waste Management Plan (HS-PLN-0004); the soil and groundwater baseline (HS-RPT-0003) shall be established before construction so that any contamination can be attributed.
